p4_b0.ocr: In the shipping and maritime industry, the volatility of bunker fuel prices plays a critical role in operational budgeting and overall cost management. Notably, the total estimated cost for 50,000 metric tons of Heavy Fuel Oil reached CAD 70,000, underscoring the importance of strategic procurement decisions.
